title: Papyrus Lint Export for AI document
description: The JSON document downloaded by the desktop app's Export for AI feature. It contains the currently filtered lint findings and metadata for each recognized rule represented in those findings.

rule_details.description: Tag metadata for each recognized rule represented in findings. Triggered rule ids for which Papyrus Lint has no metadata are omitted.

tool.description: The application that produced this document.

version.description: The running desktop app's version, or `unknown` when it could not be read.

website.description: The Papyrus Lint website, where additional rule and configuration documentation is available.

target_game.description: The Papyrus dialect/engine these findings and rule details were produced for. Papyrus Lint has no per-project game/edition setting, so this is fixed.

findingsReport.description: The filtered findings, in the same shape as the desktop app's Export issues JSON report.

files_with_diagnostics.description: The number of exported files that have at least one diagnostic.

total_diagnostics.description: The total number of exported diagnostics across all files.

path.description: The script path relative to the currently loaded project when possible.

diagnostics.description: The diagnostics for this script that passed every active results filter.

line.description: The 1-indexed source line where the diagnostic starts.

column.description: The 1-indexed source column where the diagnostic starts.

rule.description: The stable, hyphenated lint rule id, or `unknown` for a diagnostic without one.

level.description: The diagnostic severity. Untagged external diagnostics are classified as errors.

message.description: The human-readable diagnostic message, including its severity prefix when classified.

rule.description: The stable, hyphenated identifier of the lint rule.

kinds.description: The classes of issue this rule detects.

auto_fixable.description: Whether Papyrus Lint can automatically fix this rule's findings.
